schema.name: Sansamaan Visitor Persona, Interview Log & FAQ Dataset
schema.description: 山莎蔓岸合作社訪客研究資料底盤 — 3 條 Persona + 3 場 Interview Log + 12 題訪客 FAQ + Persona × Section 對應矩陣。對位國泰金控 JD I0001759 第 2 條（用戶訪談 / 設計工作坊 / 用戶測試）。
schema.method_disclosure: Reverse-Engineered Artefact — 訪談紀錄基於合作社 2025-09 ~ 2025-11 真實接待場景反向整理；非開發前 waterfall 產出，符合敏捷精神。
source: 2025-09-07 明新科大 USR 學生入山實作（7 張紀實照片 + 現場互動）
2025-11-17 其他社區老人來園區參訪（3 張紀實照片 + 帶隊長對話）
2025-Q4 企業 ESG 採購窗口電話諮詢 1 場（合作社理事長口述回憶）

demographics.role_zh: 明新科大 USR 計畫修課學生
demographics.channel_zh: 由學校老師帶隊，第一次接觸部落
demographics.channel_en: Brought in by university faculty; first-time tribal visit

personas.primary_motivation_zh: 完成 USR 學分要求 + 想了解低碳產業實作
personas.primary_motivation_en: Fulfill USR credit requirements + understand low-carbon industry hands-on

pain_points.zh: 這邊是什麼？做什麼？什麼時候成立？三秒內看不到答案就想退站
pain_points.en: What is this place / what do you do / when founded — bounce in 3 seconds if unclear

pain_points.zh: 怕被當免費勞動力，不想只去做完就走
pain_points.en: Worry about being treated as free labor with no takeaway

pain_points.zh: 看不懂網站的 ESG / 碳匯 / SDG 等專業術語
pain_points.en: Cannot decode ESG / carbon-sink / SDG jargon

expectations.zh: 5 分鐘內理解合作社的事業全貌
expectations.en: Grasp the co-op's business in 5 minutes

expectations.zh: 看到過往學生實作的真實照片與成果
expectations.en: See real photos of previous students' work and outcomes

expectations.zh: 明確的時長 / 行程 / 安全須知

key_questions: Q4 我來這邊會做什麼？

personas.name_zh: 鄰近社區理事長 · 黃理事長

demographics.role_zh: 鄰近社區發展協會理事長 / 帶隊長
demographics.channel_zh: 口耳相傳 + 友社推薦，自費組團來訪
demographics.channel_en: Word-of-mouth + peer-association referral; self-funded group visit

personas.primary_motivation_zh: 為社區長輩規劃文化交流與健康活動
personas.primary_motivation_en: Plan cultural-exchange and wellness activities for community elders

pain_points.zh: 怕路途太遠、山路顛簸長輩受不了
pain_points.en: Worry about long mountain drive being hard on elders

pain_points.zh: 不知道有沒有無障礙設施、廁所、休息區
pain_points.en: Unsure about accessibility, restrooms, and rest areas

pain_points.zh: 團體 10-15 人成本能否壓在合理範圍
pain_points.en: Group cost of 10-15 people staying within budget

expectations.zh: 預估車程 + 公車路線 + 停車空間明確說明
expectations.en: Clear driving time + bus routes + parking info

expectations.zh: 可選半日 / 一日的彈性方案
活動內容偏輕量（不要太多走路、不要太多勞動）
expectations.en: Light activity load (less walking, less heavy labor)

personas.name_zh: 企業 ESG 採購窗口 · 陳專員

demographics.role_zh: 上市公司 CSR / 永續部 / 採購窗口
demographics.channel_zh: Google 搜尋『原民部落 ESG 採購』+ LinkedIn 找窗口
demographics.channel_en: Google search 'indigenous ESG procurement' + LinkedIn outreach

personas.primary_motivation_zh: 為公司年度 ESG 報告書找可被揭露的碳匯認養 / 員工 CSR 活動
personas.primary_motivation_en: Source disclosable carbon-sink adoption / CSR activities for annual ESG report

pain_points.zh: 碳數據沒辦法被會計師認列就無法寫進報告
pain_points.en: Carbon data unverifiable by auditors cannot enter the report

pain_points.zh: 需要能開立統編、可申報為合法成本的單據
pain_points.en: Need invoices with tax-ID, deductible as legitimate cost

pain_points.zh: 對口窗口分散（合作社、部落、政府）會讓採購流程拖三個月
pain_points.en: Fragmented contacts (co-op / tribe / gov) stall procurement for 3 months

expectations.zh: 首頁就能看到具體碳匯數據（噸 / 公頃 / 年）
expectations.en: Concrete carbon metrics (tonnes / ha / year) visible on homepage

expectations.zh: 明確說明：1 份合約、1 個窗口、1 套發票流程
expectations.en: Clear messaging: one contract, one contact, one invoicing flow

expectations.zh: 至少 1 個企業合作 case study 可佐證
expectations.en: At least 1 enterprise case study to verify

key_questions: Q1 碳數據可以列入我們 ESG 報告嗎？
Q2 能不能開立發票 / 統一編號？
Q3 你們有跟哪些企業合作過？
Q4 最低成團人數是多少？
Q5 從接洽到出貨 / 出團要多久？

interview_logs.title_zh: 明新科大 USR 學生入山實作
interview_logs.participants_zh: 6 名學生 + 1 名指導老師 + 合作社理事長 + 竹編師傅
interview_logs.participants_en: 6 students + 1 faculty advisor + co-op chair + master bamboo craftsman
interview_logs.deliverable_zh: 完成入口竹柵欄 1 座
interview_logs.method_zh: 現場參與式觀察 + 結束前 30 分鐘焦點訪談
interview_logs.S_situation_zh: 學生第一次踏入賽夏部落，對『竹炭怎麼做』、『為什麼要做』、『合作社是什麼』完全空白；理事長花了 20 分鐘口頭介紹，但學生眼神渙散，期待『實作』而非『聽課』。
interview_logs.S_situation_en: Students stepping into the Saisiyat village for the first time; no prior knowledge of charcoal-making, motivation, or what a co-op is. The chair gave a 20-min verbal intro, but students lost focus — they expected hands-on, not a lecture.
interview_logs.T_task_zh: 讓學生在 4 小時內既完成實體交付（竹柵欄），又能帶走『合作社到底在做什麼』的清晰認知。
interview_logs.T_task_en: Within 4 hours, deliver both a physical outcome (fence) and a clear takeaway: what the co-op actually does.
interview_logs.A_action_zh: (1) 改先做後說 — 學生到場直接分組砍竹、削皮、組裝；(2) 過程中竹編師傅一邊做一邊用閩南語混台語介紹文化典故；(3) 結束前 30 分鐘把師傅、理事長、學校老師三方圍坐，學生自由發問。
interview_logs.A_action_en: (1) Switched to do-first-explain-later — students harvested, peeled, assembled bamboo on arrival; (2) Master craftsman narrated cultural context in mixed Hokkien-Taiwanese while working; (3) Final 30-min open Q&A with master / chair / faculty in circle.
interview_logs.R_result_zh: 竹柵欄完工；學生 6 人在會議室報告心得時皆能正確回答『合作社做什麼』、『為什麼是合作社不是公司』、『竹炭跟一般炭差在哪』三題。指導老師當場詢問下一梯次合作時程。
interview_logs.R_result_en: Fence completed; all 6 students correctly answered three core questions in the wrap-up. Faculty advisor immediately inquired about next batch scheduling.

design_feedback_for_client_site.zh: 客戶網站 #about 必須在第一句就說『我們是誰、做什麼』，禁止 6 句敘事鋪陳
design_feedback_for_client_site.en: Client site #about must declare who/what in first sentence — no 6-line buildup

design_feedback_for_client_site.zh: #cases 必須有『學生實作』案例，而且要有照片佐證
design_feedback_for_client_site.en: #cases must include a 'student hands-on' case with photo evidence

design_feedback_for_client_site.zh: #plans 教育卡要明確標示時長 + 交付物 + 是否需要先備知識
design_feedback_for_client_site.en: #plans Education card must show duration + deliverable + prerequisites

interview_logs.title_zh: 鄰近社區老人來園區參訪
interview_logs.participants_zh: 12 位社區長輩 + 黃理事長帶隊 + 合作社發起人接待
interview_logs.participants_en: 12 community elders + Chair Huang as leader + co-op founder hosting
interview_logs.deliverable_zh: 場域導覽 + 茶點交流 + 紀念合影
interview_logs.deliverable_en: Site tour + tea & snacks + group photo
interview_logs.method_zh: 全程半結構式觀察 + 中場休息時與帶隊長 15 分鐘訪談
interview_logs.method_en: Semi-structured observation + 15-min interview with tour leader during break
interview_logs.S_situation_zh: 長輩們對山路顛簸、上山時間長頗有微詞；下車後第一句話多是『廁所在哪』、『有沒有椅子』；發起人原本準備了 1 小時的『竹炭升級歷程』導覽，發現長輩 20 分鐘就累了。
interview_logs.S_situation_en: Elders complained about bumpy mountain roads and long drive time; first questions off the bus were 'where's the restroom' and 'is there seating'; the founder's planned 1-hour 'charcoal upgrade journey' tour exhausted them at 20 min.
interview_logs.T_task_zh: 把原本『單向技術導覽』改為『雙向文化交流』，並補強體力相關設施／資訊。
interview_logs.T_task_en: Pivot from one-way technical tour to two-way cultural exchange, plus strengthen physical/info accessibility.
interview_logs.A_action_zh: (1) 把導覽路線砍半，留 40 分鐘在涼亭區喝茶聊天；(2) 帶隊長主動分享他們社區的竹工藝歷史，形成互動；(3) 結束前發起人記錄到『下次團體來訪前先發行前須知（距離、廁所、座位、最低成團）』。
interview_logs.A_action_en: (1) Halved the tour route; kept 40 min for tea & chat at the pavilion; (2) Tour leader spontaneously shared their community's bamboo-craft history, creating exchange; (3) Founder logged 'send pre-visit notice (distance / restroom / seating / min group size) to future group bookings'.
interview_logs.R_result_zh: 長輩走時主動詢問下次什麼時候可以再來、能不能推薦給其他社區；3 張合影照片成為客戶網站 #cases 區的『社區參訪』類別補件。
interview_logs.R_result_en: Elders proactively asked when they could return and whether they could recommend to other communities; 3 group photos became 'community-visit' category fillers for #cases.

design_feedback_for_client_site.zh: 客戶網站 #venue 必須加『找到我們』微區：地圖、車程、停車、廁所
design_feedback_for_client_site.en: Client site #venue needs a 'find us' micro-section: map / driving time / parking / restrooms

design_feedback_for_client_site.zh: #plans 必須補一張『銀髮社區方案』，明確標示最低成團人數與輕量行程
design_feedback_for_client_site.en: #plans needs a new 'Senior Community' card with min group size and light itinerary

design_feedback_for_client_site.zh: #contact FAQ 必須加『下雨會取消嗎』、『最低成團人數』兩題
design_feedback_for_client_site.en: #contact FAQ must add 'rain cancellation' and 'min group size' questions

interview_logs.title_zh: 企業 ESG 採購窗口電話諮詢
interview_logs.participants_zh: 某上市公司 CSR 部專員 1 名 + 合作社理事長
interview_logs.participants_en: 1 CSR specialist from a listed company + co-op chair
interview_logs.deliverable_zh: 提案需求書草稿（未成案，但建立窗口）
interview_logs.deliverable_en: Draft proposal scope (no contract yet, but channel established)
interview_logs.method_zh: 首次來電 30 分鐘需求釐清 + 後續 Email 15 分鐘規格回覆
interview_logs.method_en: First 30-min phone scoping + follow-up 15-min email specification reply
interview_logs.S_situation_zh: 對方來電第一句即問『你們的碳數據可以列入我們的 ESG 報告書嗎？』、『可以開立統編嗎？』── 兩個問題都決定『我們會不會繼續談下去』。理事長當下未能精準回答，整通電話折損 15 分鐘在釐清『碳數據怎麼算』。
interview_logs.S_situation_en: Caller opened with two gating questions: 'Can your carbon data go into our ESG report?' and 'Can you issue invoices with our tax ID?' — both determine 'do we continue or not'. The chair couldn't answer precisely on the spot; 15 min wasted clarifying carbon-data methodology.
interview_logs.T_task_zh: 讓首頁 + 5 分鐘瀏覽即可獨立回答企業窗口的兩個 gating 問題。
interview_logs.T_task_en: Make the homepage + 5-minute browse self-sufficient to answer both gating questions.
interview_logs.A_action_zh: (1) 把 7,526 m² × 77.3 tC/ha 等具體數據塞進客戶網站 Hero fact chips；(2) FAQ 明確寫『可開立統編』與『碳數據揭露格式對齊 GHG Protocol』；(3) 把 carbon-data.json 開放下載，作為『可被會計師查驗』的證據。
interview_logs.A_action_en: (1) Embedded 7,526 m² × 77.3 tC/ha figures into client-site Hero fact chips; (2) FAQ explicitly states 'tax-ID invoicing supported' and 'carbon data follows GHG Protocol disclosure'; (3) Made carbon-data.json publicly downloadable as auditor-verifiable evidence.
interview_logs.R_result_zh: 後續第二家企業電話來訪時，對方主動表示『你們網站上的數據我已經看過，今天想直接談合約』── 從 5 分鐘討論進入合約面，整體採購週期由 3 個月壓縮為 4 週。
interview_logs.R_result_en: On the next enterprise call, the caller stated 'I've already reviewed your site data; today let's go straight to contract' — 5-min discussion to contract phase, compressing the procurement cycle from 3 months to 4 weeks.

design_feedback_for_client_site.zh: 客戶網站 Hero fact chips 必須包含碳匯具體數據
design_feedback_for_client_site.en: Client-site Hero fact chips must include concrete carbon metrics

design_feedback_for_client_site.zh: FAQ 必須有『可開統編』、『ESG 報告書揭露』、『最低成團』、『接洽到出貨週期』四題
design_feedback_for_client_site.en: FAQ must cover invoicing / ESG disclosure / min group / lead-time

design_feedback_for_client_site.zh: #why-us 必須連結 carbon-data.json 下載按鈕
design_feedback_for_client_site.en: #why-us must link to the carbon-data.json download button

items.a_zh: 2024 年 11 月成立的賽夏族大隘部落低碳竹產業合作社，主場在新竹縣五峰鄉 12 公頃竹林。
items.a_en: A Saisiyat-led low-carbon bamboo industry co-op founded in Nov 2024 at the Daai village, operating across 12 hectares of bamboo forest in Wufeng, Hsinchu.

items.a_zh: 把竹子做成炭、把炭做成 ESG 採購案；同時提供學校 USR、企業 CSR、文化參訪三類體驗。
items.a_en: Turn bamboo into charcoal, charcoal into ESG procurement contracts; offer school USR, corporate CSR, and cultural-visit experiences.

items.a_zh: 合作社於 2024 年 11 月正式登記，但合作社核心成員自 2021 年起便以個人身份投入大隘部落地方創生研究。
items.a_en: Co-op formally registered in Nov 2024; core members had been engaged in Daai-village revitalization research since 2021.

items.q_zh: 從新竹市區開車過來要多久？
items.q_en: How long is the drive from Hsinchu City?
items.a_zh: 約 1 小時 10 分鐘（44 公里），全程鋪設路面；最後 5 公里為山區路段，建議自小客車前往。
items.a_en: About 1h 10min (44 km), fully paved; final 5 km is mountain road, sedan recommended.

items.q_en: What is the minimum group size?
items.a_zh: 教育與企業方案最少 10 人成團；文化體驗 4 人即可；銀髮社區方案 8 人成團，皆可加價彈性調整。
items.a_en: Education and Enterprise plans: min 10 people; Culture plan: min 4; Senior Community plan: min 8 — surcharge available for smaller groups.

items.q_en: Do you cancel on rainy days?
items.a_zh: 小雨照常（場域內有涼亭與室內竹炭屋遮蔽）；豪大雨依氣象署黃色警戒以上於前一日 17:00 前通知改期。
items.a_en: Light rain: proceed (pavilion & indoor charcoal house provide shelter); heavy rain (CWB yellow alert+): rescheduled with notice by 17:00 the prior day.

items.q_zh: 可以選素食或特殊飲食嗎？
items.q_en: Can we request vegetarian or special diets?
items.a_zh: 可以，預約備註欄填寫即可；蛋奶素、純素、無麩質、過敏原皆能配合，需提前 3 天告知。
items.a_en: Yes, indicate in the booking notes; lacto-ovo, vegan, gluten-free, allergens supported with 3-day advance notice.

items.q_zh: 能不能開立發票 / 統一編號？
items.q_en: Can you issue invoices with tax ID?
items.a_zh: 可以。合作社統一編號 95216178，可開立電子發票或紙本三聯式，符合營業稅法。
items.a_en: Yes. Co-op tax ID 95216178; e-invoice or paper triplicate, fully compliant with VAT regulations.

items.q_zh: 碳數據可以列入我們企業的 ESG 報告嗎？
items.q_en: Can your carbon data be included in our ESG report?
items.a_zh: 可以。我們提供基於 RTK 多光譜空拍實測的 7,526.16 m² 樣區基線（77.3 tC/ha），對齊 GHG Protocol 揭露格式，可直接引用於 ESG 報告 Scope 3 章節。
items.a_en: Yes. We provide an RTK multispectral aerial baseline of 7,526.16 m² (77.3 tC/ha), aligned with GHG Protocol disclosure for ESG Scope 3 reporting.

items.q_zh: 從接洽到出團 / 出貨要多久？
items.q_en: What is the lead time from inquiry to delivery?
items.a_zh: 標準體驗方案 2 週前敲定；企業客製 ESG 採購案 4-6 週；碳匯認養合約因需法律審視，建議預留 8 週。
items.a_en: Standard experience: 2 weeks; enterprise custom CSR: 4-6 weeks; carbon-sink adoption contracts (with legal review): 8 weeks recommended.

items.q_zh: 可以團體預約或客製化嗎？
items.q_en: Can we book as a group or customize?
items.a_zh: 都可以。團體 10 人以上享 8 折優惠；客製化方案請於預約表單『備註』填寫需求，3 個工作天內回覆可行性與報價。
items.a_en: Both supported. Groups of 10+: 20% off; custom packages: note in booking form, get feasibility & quote within 3 business days.

items.q_zh: 請問預約之後多久會收到確認？
items.q_en: How soon will I receive confirmation after booking?
items.a_zh: 3 個工作天內以 Email 回覆確認與行前須知；若 5 天未收到請來電 0975958121 確認。
items.a_en: Email confirmation + pre-visit notes within 3 business days; if not received within 5 days, please call 0975958121.

persona_section_matrix.description_zh: Persona × 客戶網站 Section × 待解問題的對應矩陣 — 證明本案 IA 設計直接源自用戶研究。
persona_section_matrix.description_en: Persona × Section × Question matrix — proves IA design is grounded in user research.
